newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's police to create anti-hacker team.
newsitem.headline: Japan's police to create anti-hacker team.

text.p: Japanese police said on Friday they would set up a special unit to try to stem a spread of computer viruses and other attacks by hackers.
The National Police Agency (NPA) said funds for the new unit were requested as part of a 253 billion yen ($2.34 billion) budget for fiscal 1997/98 submitted in the morning.
A spokesman for the agency said the "Security Systems Countermeasures Team" would be created in the next fiscal year beginning April 1997.

Other new sections and posts include special units to be set up in each of the police headquarters of Japan's 47 prefectures to deal with the increase in crimes related to bad loans, real estate companies, banks and other money-lending institutions.
The agency was also creating a team to combat an increase in the number of cases of fraud in the pachinko gaming parlour business, the spokesman said.
